{{main|1973–74 Copa del Generalísimo}}

The '''Copa del Generalísimo 1974 final''' was the 72nd final of the [[Copa del Rey|King's Cup]]. It was played at [[Vicente Calderón Stadium]] in [[Madrid]] on 28 June 1974, with [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] beating [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] 4–0 for their 12th title.
{{-}}
